description: Juan Reyes Sierra, a UCF senior, shares his father’s account of being with President Bush on the morning of September 11, 2001; Reyes Sierra says he was not yet born at the time. Reyes Sierra says his father was a manager at the Colony Beach and Resort in Longboat Key, Florida, and was responsible for logistics during President Bush’s stay there before the president went to Booker Elementary School in Sarasota. According to Reyes Sierra, his father helped prepare a brunch menu for the president and took a photograph with him. Reyes Sierra recounts that his father later saw Sarasota Airport shut down and fighter jets, amid concern that the president might be targeted. Framing the account as his father’s experience rather than his own, Reyes Sierra says he feels proud to share the story and remembers his father’s lasting sense of amazement about the encounter. Recorded on September 11, 2026, this oral history is part of the UCF Remembers 9/11 collection.
